thread:
Ashwin: heads-up, kicking off config-only deploy for routing + batching tweaks (config id cfg_3a7f). change window noon-1pm PT. canary 5% for 15m.

deploy-bot: config rollout started: id=cfg_3a7f, mode=config-only, percent=5

Maria D: watching p50/p95/p99 latency, rpc errors, and token/sec billing. if p95 > 150ms for 10m -> escalate.

Olivia: noting downstream latency risk for short requests. suggest fallback/pinning policy: fallback_model="legacy-v1.9" when latency threshold hit.

Kevin: ack. can we add a soft per-tenant throttle for the canary? recommend 30 req/s to limit noisier tenants.

Ashwin: adding throttle. CLI to apply: 
```
redwoodctl rollout apply --config cfg_3a7f --canary 5 --throttle 30
```

sre-oncall: i'll watch infra dashboards (cpu, queue depth, grpc backpressure). if queue depth > 500 for 5m we demote canary to 0 and rollback config.

Maria D: also enable 1% detailed sampling for request metadata (prompt length, model variant) so we can correlate latencies.

deploy-bot: canary updated: throttle=30, sampling=1%

Olivia: rules of engagement: abort if errors >= 1% sustained for 10m OR p95 > 200ms for 10m. otherwise at +30m we ramp to 25%.

Ashwin: agreed. rollback plan is the usual: pin routes to previous routing table + revert batching params, notify infra, open incident if rollback triggered. postmortem checklist prepared. ping here with "canary ok" when metrics stable.

Kevin: canary ok @ +22m — p95=120ms, errors=0.02%, queue=120. moving to 25% in 5.

deploy-bot: scheduled ramp to 25% in 5m (task id ramp_9b2c)

sre-oncall: noted — will stay on until end of window and monitor traces. :thumbsup:
